description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzLikeOnShareAPI class, which provides API endpoints related to liking and unliking shares/posts within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes methods for listing likes, adding a like, and removing a like on a share/post, utilizing various traits and integrating with the data access objects for BuzzShare and BuzzLikeOnShare entities.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller managing likes on shared posts in the Buzz module. It provides methods to list, add, and remove likes, utilizing traits for authentication, service access, and ORM helper functions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of likes on a specific share/post, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a like to a specific share/post, preventing duplicates and updating like counts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a like from a share/post, ensuring the like exists before removing.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Sets the share ID and employee number on a BuzzLikeOnShare entity based on request parameters and authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns parameter validation rules for listing likes, including share ID and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a like, mainly validating the share ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting a like, mainly validating the share ID.
